```{r}
#| eval: false

my_location <- "Pittsburgh, PA"

weather_history_safe <- safely(.f = weather_history, quiet = FALSE)

get_weather_data <- function(location, decade, start, end) {
  filename <- glue(
    "/Users/conorotompkins/Documents/github_repos/ctompkins_quarto_blog/posts/pittsburgh_weather_pca/post_data/weather_data_{decade}.parquet"
  )

  if (file.exists(filename)) {
    print(glue("{filename} exists"))
  } else {
    print(glue("Fetching weather for {location} {start} to {end}"))

    x <- weather_history_safe(
      location = location,
      start = start,
      end = end,
      daily = weather_variables()$daily_history_vars
    ) |>
      mutate(location = location, .before = 1)

    if (is.null(x$error)) {
      write_parquet(x$result, filename)
    } else {
      print(x$error)
    }
  }
}

weather_target <- tibble(
  my_location = my_location,
  decade = seq(1940, 2020, by = 10),
  start = glue("{decade}-01-01") |> ymd(),
  end = glue("{decade + 9}-12-31") |> ymd()
) |>
  mutate(
    end = case_when(end == max(end) ~ Sys.Date() - days(1), .default = end)
  )

weather_target |>
  slice_head(n = 4) |>
  mutate(
    data = pwalk(
      .l = list(my_location, decade, start, end),
      .f = get_weather_data
    )
  )
```

```{r}
weather_data <- open_dataset(
  "posts/pittsburgh_weather_pca/post_data"
) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    decade = year(date) %/% 10,
    decade = str_c(decade, "0's"),
    year = year(date),
    yday = yday(date),
    month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
    mday = mday(date)
  ) |>
  mutate(location = "Pittsburgh, PA", .before = 1) |>
  select(location, date, decade, year, month, yday, mday, everything())

glimpse(weather_data)

weather_data |>
  count(decade)
```


```{r}
drop_bad_cols <- function(x) {
  bad_cols <- x |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "column_name",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    summarize(is_constant = n_distinct(value) == 1, .by = column_name) |>
    filter(is_constant == TRUE) |>
    distinct(column_name) |>
    pull(column_name)

  print(str_c("dropping ", str_c(bad_cols, collapse = ", ")))

  x <- select(x, -all_of(bad_cols))
}
```

```{r}
weather_data_hist <- weather_data |>
  filter(year < 2000, date > "1940-01-01")

weather_data_recent <- anti_join(
  weather_data,
  weather_data_hist,
  by = "date"
) |>
  filter(date > "1940-01-01")

count(weather_data_recent, decade)

pca_inputs <- weather_data_hist |>
  select(-c(year, yday, decade, month, mday, daily_weather_code)) |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  drop_bad_cols()

glimpse(pca_inputs)

pca_fit <- prcomp(pca_inputs, scale = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pca_values <- pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues")

pca_values |>
  ggplot(aes(PC, percent)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:nrow(pca_values)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

weather_data_hist_pca <- pca_fit |>
  augment(weather_data_hist) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^.fittedPC", "pc")) |>
  select(all_of(names(weather_data_hist)), pc1:pc5)

weather_data_recent_pca <- bind_cols(
  weather_data_recent,
  predict(pca_fit, weather_data_recent)
) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^PC", "pc")) |>
  select(all_of(names(weather_data_hist)), pc1:pc5)

glimpse(weather_data_hist_pca)
```

```{r}
# define arrow style for plotting

  angle = 20,
  ends = "first",
  type = "closed",
  length = grid::unit(8, "pt")
)

# plot rotation matrix
pca_rot <- pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "rotation") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "PC", names_prefix = "PC", values_from = "value") |>
  rename_with(str_to_lower) |>
  select(column, pc1:pc5)

pca_rot |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -column, names_to = "pc", values_to = "pc_value") |>
  group_by(pc) |>
  slice_max(order_by = abs(pc_value), n = 5) |>
  mutate(id = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  print(n = Inf)

pc_labels <- list(
  pc1 = "PC1: Higher temperatures, lower soil moisture",
  pc2 = "PC2: Lower humidity and less rain, more sunshine and higher pressure",
  pc3 = "PC3: Higher wind, lower atmospheric pressure",
  pc4 = "PC4: Lower soil moisture, less shortwave radiation",
  pc5 = "PC5: Less preciptation (rain/snow), some wind direction"
)

pc_labels$pc1

pc_label <- function(x) {
  pluck(pc_labels, x)
}

pc_label("pc1")
```

```{r}
graph_pca_rot <- function(pca_df, x, y) {
  pca_df |>
    mutate(text = str_replace_all(column, "_", " ") |> str_wrap(16)) |>
    ggplot(aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]])) +
    geom_segment(xend = 0, yend = 0, arrow = arrow_style) +
    geom_label(
      aes(label = text),
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = .2)) +
    labs(x = pc_label(x), y = pc_label(y))
}

pca_rot |>
  graph_pca_rot("pc1", "pc2")

pca_rot |>
  graph_pca_rot("pc1", "pc3")

pca_rot |>
  graph_pca_rot("pc1", "pc4")
```

```{r}
weather_data_hist_pca_time <- weather_data_hist_pca |>
  select(date, month, decade, yday, year, starts_with("pc"))

quantile_df <- function(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) {
  tibble(
    val = quantile(x, probs, na.rm = TRUE),
    quant = probs
  )
}

historical_range <- weather_data_hist_pca_time |>
  select(date, yday, pc1:pc5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc")) |>
  reframe(quantile_df(value), .by = c(yday, name)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = quant, values_from = val, names_prefix = "pct_") |>
  arrange(name, yday)

historical_range

weather_data_hist_pca_time |>
  select(date, decade, pc1:pc5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc")) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, color = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(vars(decade), ncol = 1, scales = "free_x")
```

```{r}
weather_data_hist_pca_time |>
  select(yday, year, decade, pc1:pc5) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pc")) |>
  ggplot(aes(yday, value, group = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = historical_range,
    aes(x = yday, ymin = pct_0.25, ymax = pct_0.75),
    alpha = .3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = decade, color = decade), lwd = .5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Decadal PC value vs. historical range (25-75 percentile)",
    x = "Day of year",
    y = "PCA value",
    color = "Decade"
  )
```

### Clustering

```{r}
# test multiple clustering algorithms

methods <- c(
  "ward.D",
  "ward.D2",
  "single",
  "complete",
  "average",
  "mcquitty",
  "median",
  "centroid"
)

#methods <- c("ward.D2", "centroid")

cluster_specs <- map(
  methods,
  ~ hier_clust(
    num_clusters = 4,
    linkage_method = .x
  )
) |>
  set_names(methods)

cluster_specs

fit_cluster <- function(x) {
  x |>
    fit(
      ~.,
      data = weather_data_hist_pca_time |>
        #filter(date < "1980-01-01") |>
        select(pc1:pc5) |>
        slice_sample(prop = .1)
    )
}

fitted_clusters <- cluster_specs |>
  map(fit_cluster)

names(fitted_clusters)
```

```{r}
# base R plotting
plot_tree <- function(x) {
  x$fit |> plot(labels = FALSE)
}

length(fitted_clusters)
par(mfrow = c(2, 4))

fitted_clusters |>
  walk(plot_tree)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# ggraph
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(patchwork)

method_tbl <- tibble(method = methods, cluster_fit = fitted_clusters)

method_tbl |>
  filter(method == "ward.D2") |>
  pull(cluster_fit) |>
  pluck(1) |>
  pluck("fit") |>
  as.dendrogram() |>
  as_tbl_graph() |>
  filter(height > 10) |>
  ggraph(layout = "dendrogram", height = height) +
  geom_edge_elbow()

get_dendrogram <- function(x) {
  x |>
    pluck("fit") |>
    as.dendrogram()
}

plot_dendrogram <- function(x, method, height_cut = 0) {
  cluster_method <- x |>
    as_tbl_graph() |>
    filter(height > height_cut) |>
    ggraph(layout = "dendrogram", height = height) +
    geom_edge_elbow() +
    labs(title = method)
}

plot_dendrogram <- possibly(plot_dendrogram)

method_tbl <- method_tbl |>
  mutate(
    dendrogram = map(cluster_fit, get_dendrogram),
    plot = pmap(list(dendrogram, method), plot_dendrogram)
  )

method_tbl

method_tbl |>
  filter(method == "median") |>
  pull(plot)

compare_methods_plot <- method_tbl |>
  #filter(method != "single") |>
  pull(plot) |>
  wrap_plots(ncol = 3)

compare_methods_plot
```

### Predict clusters onto recent data

```{r}
recent_cluster_assignments <- bind_cols(
  weather_data_recent_pca,
  predict(hc_fit, weather_data_recent_pca)
) |>
  rename(.cluster = .pred_cluster)

recent_cluster_assignments |>
  count(.cluster)

weather_clusters_combined <- bind_rows(
  cluster_assignments,
  recent_cluster_assignments
) |>
  select(-.cluster_label) |>
  left_join(cluster_labels, by = ".cluster")

glimpse(weather_clusters_combined)

weather_clusters_combined |>
  count(decade, .cluster, .cluster_label) |>
  view()

weather_clusters_combined |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yday, y = year, fill = .cluster_label)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2000) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(0)) +
  scale_y_reverse(expand = expansion(0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_pal) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster analysis of Pittsburgh seasons",
    subtitle = "Clustering trained on pre-2000 data, predicted onto post-2000 data",
    x = "Day of year",
    y = "Year",
    fill = "Cluster"
  )

cluster_summary <- weather_clusters_combined |>
  mutate(decade = year(date) %/% 10) |>
  filter(year != max(year)) |>
  summarize(
    avg_start = mean(min(yday)),
    avg_end = mean(max(yday)),
    days = n(),
    .by = c(.cluster, year)
  ) |>
  left_join(cluster_labels)

cluster_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = days, fill = .cluster_label)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_pal) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Days of year per cluster",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Days",
    fill = "Cluster"
  )

cluster_summary |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(.cluster, .cluster_label, year)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, color = .cluster_label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .2) +
  geom_smooth() +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_pal) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Day of year")
```
